## Generated by svn_build.py (COLDWAR_SVN generator, stages B1-B2) from the approved design of 12.11.2026. Edit the generator or the design, not this file.

COLDWAR_SVN_is_1970 = {
	original_tag = SVN
	IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
}

# AI path: historical = the Thieu government (Order Before Liberty, Rule Through the Palace, The Uncontested Ballot, Thieu tree a1 b2 c2 d1 e1).
COLDWAR_SVN_ai_historical_path = {
	is_historical_focus_on = yes
}

# Power focuses: never in the historical mode, and only one handover for the AI.
COLDWAR_SVN_ai_handover_blocked = {
	OR = {
		is_historical_focus_on = yes
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_handover_done
	}
}

# MD doubles a POSITIVE faction gain while an autocratic party governs (autocrats_opinion_change in
# 00_internal_faction_effects.txt: western_autocrats_are_in_power or ruling_party 7, 13, 21, 22; factor 2).
# Positive faction lines of the tree book half the design value while this holds, so the player gets the design value.
COLDWAR_SVN_faction_doubling = {
	OR = {
		western_autocrats_are_in_power = yes
		check_variable = { ruling_party = 7 }
		check_variable = { ruling_party = 13 }
		check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
		check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
	}
}

	country_exists = SOV
	SVN = { NOT = { has_war_with = SOV } }
	SVN = {
		NOT = { is_embargoing = SOV }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = SOV }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = SOV }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = SOV }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = SOV }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = SOV }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = SOV }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = SOV }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = SOV }
			}
		}
	}
	SOV = {
		NOT = { is_embargoing = SVN }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
			}
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_d_align_f_active = {
	COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_d_align_f_pair_clear = yes
	SVN = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_d_align_f_signed }
	SOV = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_d_align_f_consent }
}
COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_d_align_f_can_accept = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_open_tt
		tag = SOV
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_d_align_f_pending
		NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_d_align_f_consent }
		country_exists = SVN
		SVN = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_d_align_f_open
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_d_align_f_signed }
		}
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_sender_tt
		has_variable = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_d_align_f_sender
		var:COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_d_align_f_sender = { tag = SVN }
	}
	SVN = {
		custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_same_government_tt
			check_variable = { ruling_party = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_d_align_f_party }
		}
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_peace_tt
		NOT = { has_war_with = SVN }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_no_sanctions_tt
		SVN = {
			NOT = { is_embargoing = SOV }
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = SOV }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = SOV }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = SOV }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = SOV }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = SOV }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = SOV }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = SOV }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = SOV }
				}
			}
		}
		SOV = {
			NOT = { is_embargoing = SVN }
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_d_align_f_answer_valid = {
	country_exists = SOV
	SOV = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_d_align_f_consent }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_d_align_f_signed }
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_same_government_tt
		check_variable = { ruling_party = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_prg_d_align_f_party }
	}
}
# Offer 6: Withdrawal and Reconstruction Compact (USA)
COLDWAR_SVN_offer_third_phased_pair_clear = {
	country_exists = SVN
	country_exists = USA
	SVN = { NOT = { has_war_with = USA } }
	SVN = {
		NOT = { is_embargoing = USA }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = USA }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = USA }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = USA }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = USA }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = USA }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = USA }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = USA }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = USA }
			}
		}
	}
	USA = {
		NOT = { is_embargoing = SVN }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
			}
		}
	}
}

	COLDWAR_SVN_offer_third_phased_pair_clear = yes
	SVN = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_third_phased_signed }
	USA = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_third_phased_consent }
}

		tooltip = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_open_tt
		tag = USA
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_third_phased_pending
		NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_third_phased_consent }

			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_third_phased_open
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_third_phased_signed }
		}

		var:COLDWAR_SVN_offer_third_phased_sender = { tag = SVN }

			tooltip = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_same_government_tt

					is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = USA }

					is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = USA }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = USA }
				}
			}
		}
		USA = {
			NOT = { is_embargoing = SVN }

					is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = SVN }

COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_a_cip_active = {
	COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_a_cip_pair_clear = yes
	SVN = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_a_cip_signed }
	USA = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_a_cip_consent }
}
COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_a_cip_can_accept = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_open_tt
		tag = USA
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_a_cip_pending
		NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_a_cip_consent }
		country_exists = SVN
		SVN = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_a_cip_open
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_a_cip_signed }
		}
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_sender_tt
		has_variable = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_a_cip_sender
		var:COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_a_cip_sender = { tag = SVN }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_peace_tt
		NOT = { has_war_with = SVN }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_no_sanctions_tt
		SVN = {
			NOT = { is_embargoing = USA }
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = USA }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = USA }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = USA }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = USA }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = USA }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = USA }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = USA }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = USA }
				}
			}
		}
		USA = {
			NOT = { is_embargoing = SVN }
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_a_cip_answer_valid = {
	country_exists = USA
	USA = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_a_cip_consent }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_a_cip_signed }
}
# Offer 10: A Written Security Assurance (USA)

	country_exists = SVN
	country_exists = USA
	SVN = { NOT = { has_war_with = USA } }
	SVN = {
		NOT = { is_embargoing = USA }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = USA }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = USA }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = USA }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = USA }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = USA }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = USA }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = USA }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = USA }
			}
		}
	}
	USA = {
		NOT = { is_embargoing = SVN }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = SVN }

					is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = TAI }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = TAI }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = TAI }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = TAI }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = TAI }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = TAI }
				}
			}
		}
		TAI = {
			NOT = { is_embargoing = SVN }
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

		}

		NOT = { has_war_with = SVN }

					is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = JAP }

			}

				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = VIE }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = VIE }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = VIE }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = VIE }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = VIE }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = VIE }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = VIE }
			}
		}
	}
	VIE = {
		NOT = { is_embargoing = SVN }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
			}
		}
	}
}

	COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_d_recog_pair_clear = yes
	SVN = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_d_recog_signed }
	VIE = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_offer_for_d_recog_consent }

					is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = VIE }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = VIE }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = VIE }
				}
			}
		}
		VIE = {
			NOT = { is_embargoing = SVN }
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = SVN }

					is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = SVN }
					is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = SVN }
